context: Cross-platform Expo mobile app with Expo web preview for heavy-metal pollution intelligence in water quality.
theme: light only; warm mint environmental base with crisp teal/green function accents
first_run: Left-aligned title, short explanation, large bordered import action, and a quiet provenance note. No fabricated map, KPIs, locations, standards or pollution values.
import_flow: Choose CSV/XLSX only -> parse -> blocking validation modal -> user fixes or cancels -> persist only valid/accepted data -> standards selection/WHO fallback trace -> calculate.
guardrails: Persist only user-imported real datasets; first-run state is genuinely empty.
Accept CSV/XLSX only and reject unsupported files before parsing.
Block invalid rows/datasets; do not silently coerce missing coordinates, units, standards or values.
Detect latitude/longitude from actual columns or geolocation service, then reverse geocode actual coordinates; record source, timestamp and confidence.
Select context-specific standards and visibly fall back to WHO only when no applicable standard is available.
Calculate HPI, HEI and Cd deterministically with versioned formulas and input traceability.
Exports must be real CSV/XLSX/PDF files generated from persisted results; never mock download completion.
AI/ML analysis, if present, must be clearly labeled as secondary and grounded only in validated data.
